values.note: 2026 rates: off-lake sites $41 a night ($246 a week), lakefront $44 ($264 a week), each plus a $3 booking fee. Monthly $660 / $725 and seasonal $1,800 / $1,905, plus electric. Campspot adds 3% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card Fee'.

fees.source: https://lakesideresortcampground.com/rates/ ('2026 Camping Rates': 'Lakefront Sites $44.00 night **plus $3.00 booking fee', 'Off Lake Sites $41.00 night', weekly, monthly and seasonal rates) + Campspot quote (audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl: base $41, 'Reservation Fee' $3, 'Credit Card Fee' $1.23), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://lakesideresortcampground.com/camping/ ('CAMPSITES INCLUDE: Full Hookup Sites ... Water hook-up, Electric hook-up (up to 50amp service)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Campspot sells 33 sites nightly (29 off-lake '30/50 Amp RV Site', 4 '30/50 Amp Waterfront RV Site'), all back-in, max length 45 ft; Motorhome and Class C listed for both types.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/lakesideresortcampground (site types 30/50 Amp RV Site: 29 sites, max 45 ft, Back-In, Motorhome Class C allowed; 30/50 Amp Waterfront RV Site: 4 sites, max 45 ft, Back-In; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13)

facilities.source: https://lakesideresortcampground.com/camping/ ('A clean, modern shower and bathroom building', 'Laundry room', 'Dump station', 'Propane fill tank', 'Camp store'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Operator's 2026 rate page confirms $41 off-lake / $44 lakefront plus a $3 booking fee (now manual), with weekly, monthly ($660-725 + electric) and seasonal ($1,800-1,905 + electric) rates. Confirmed full hookups to 50 amp, modern showers/toilets, laundry, dump station, camp store; Campspot sells 33 back-in sites nightly (max 45 ft, Class C allowed). Booking url set to the park's own /book/ link. Seasonal share: the park sells seasonal sites and the note's reviewers say most campers are seasonal, but 33 of the 66 recorded sites are on Campspot for nightly booking (~50%), so test 4 passes. Under the US$50 gate ($41, or $42.23 with the 3% card fee). Note unchanged.
flags: Website: the entry's second link is the Campspot marketplace slug https://www.campspot.com/park/lakeside-resort-campground; the operator's own booking link is https://www.campspot.com/book/lakesideresortcampground.
